searchDocs.title: Where to start​
searchDocs.content: Working on purchases, profiles, rewards, creatures, or phenomena? Start with Server runtime.Working on scanning, movement, the merchant, sound, or interface behavior? Open Client runtime.Looking for components, Mince, or shared gameplay code? Use Shared runtime.Tracing a remote from one side of the game to the other? Networking lists every named event and function with the files that use it.Looking for a module by name? Source index is the fastest route.

searchDocs.title: How the runtime is split​
searchDocs.content: Area	What lives there	FilesServer runtime	Services, systems, components, player data, and server-owned player modules	70 Client runtime	Controllers, interface code, input, and interaction handling	87 Shared runtime	Replicated components, gameplay helpers, Mince, and networking	82 Configuration	Store data, passes, settings, rarities, stats, and other runtime constants	13  The full place currently contains 1562 Luau files. This reference follows the 252 Observatory runtime files and leaves installed packages, admin systems, and Roblox's default player modules out of the way.
